exception_description: Applicant selects 'never received' when card was issued but lost; triggers card-production audit instead of reprint.

exception_description: Passport ADIT stamp date entered as card expiry; system treats stamp as valid LPR card for renewal eligibility.
Conditional resident's 2-year card expiry treated as standard 10-year cycle; I-90 filed too early without I-751 filed first.
Legal name changed by court order post-naturalization attempt; I-90 submitted with old name; biometrics mismatch.
LPR abroad with valid reentry permit; I-90 filed from overseas; USCIS jurisdiction and biometrics scheduling conflict.

exception_title: Green Card Magnetic Stripe OCR Error
exception_description: OCR reads card-back magnetic data incorrectly; A-Number last digit transposed; wrong alien file pulled.

LLM routes conditional resident to I-90 instead of I-751; incorrect form accepted without error.
Second I-90 filed while first in production; two cards printed for same alien; one must be recalled.
Prior biometrics on file but 15-month reuse window expired; system does not schedule new appointment.
Card expiry calculated as 10 years from issuance; Feb 29 issuance date creates invalid Feb 29 expiry in non-leap year.

exception_title: Lost Card Not Flagged in SAVE

LLM misclassifies extended-absence LPR as abandonment instead of SB-1 eligibility; routes to I-90 incorrectly.
Card personalization data sent to wrong regional production vendor; card printed with incorrect facility code.

exception_description: Prior card record not marked 'superseded' after I-90 approval; two active card records coexist in CLAIMS.
